question: Does the same Yang Zan manuscript write mutually discordant decimal magnitudes for the 定差 constant across its definition and its 70-limit worked example?

source.title: 楊瓚《閑中錄前集》

provider_original_pages.section: 求初限損益分 定差定義段
不用定局徑求遲疾差 七十限例

source.review_method: Manual right-to-left source-column visual reading of original full-resolution PNGs, supported by display enlargement without treating enlargement as new native pixels; no OCR promotion.

direct_original_colllation.p52_literal: 置定差一千一百一十一萬內減去立平二差
direct_original_colllation.p52_printed_remainder: 一千一百〇八萬一千五百七十五分
direct_original_colllation.p56_literal: 用此以減定差一萬一千一百一十一萬
direct_original_colllation.p56_printed_remainder: 七百五十三萬九千四百五十二分六十八秒七十五微
direct_original_colllation.transcription_scope: Character-by-character bounded vertical columns; full-page diplomatic transcription not claimed. p56 leading 一萬 visible in this same manuscript copy.

arithmetic.decimal_place_value_assumption: Ordinary base-ten Chinese 萬/千/百/十 positional reading; subsequent fixed decimal steps use exactly the local 13WQ conditional base100 分秒微 model.
arithmetic.logical_result: The p56 displayed remainder and example agree with the p52 1111萬 numeric constant, but not with the literal p56 11111萬 reading.

adjudication.positive: Original manuscript has a source-internal constant-expression mismatch at page52 versus page56, independently checked by page-bound arithmetic; p52 reading additionally fits the original initial-limit example.
possible_explanations: A copied extra leading 一萬 in the p56 constant string
An unusual punctuation/numeric grouping in manuscript usage that would require separately sourced evidence
not_proven: Where in transmission any error occurred
Which historical exemplar contained the prior reading
Any general base100 少/微 carry or Xu-An/G893 coefficient generator
adjudication.action: Preserve both original strings, prefer 11110000 only for this explicitly conditional local arithmetic reconstruction, and leave cross-edition textual emendation unresolved.

next: Seek independently authenticated Xu-An juan45 second-limit B L132 damaged 二/三 and 疾-specific coefficient constructor/radix/carry; an independent dated manuscript/print of the same Yang Zan constant phrase could resolve local textual ancestry. No same-field G893 result promoted.
